messages:
jo: Quick ask from marketing: we need a compact, reproducible bench package for the launch post and webinar. Goal: one heatmap image + raw CSV + a 2-line caveat. Keep it minimal and attach an exact reproduce command.

elena: Thanks — can we show both fp16 and a quantized int8 path? Marketing wants coldstart vs steady so the slide shows the user impact.

liam: Clarifying: which model/commit and what matrix for batch/concurrency/seqlen? Also how many samples per cell do you want?

jo: Model: redwood/3b-compat-v1 at prod pointer. Matrix: batch=1,8; concurrency=1,16; seqlens=32/256/1024. Samples: 100 per cell is fine. Percentiles: 50/95/99 per-request.

andy: We can run this tomorrow. Plan: 3 warmups, then the 100 samples. We'll capture GPU util, tokens/sec, per-request latencies, and stderr for any kernel warnings. We'll produce CSV with one row per request and a PNG heatmap.

liam: We'll also include env.txt (git sha, CUDA, driver, selected kernels). If int8 shows instability at 1024 we'll mark that cell unstable and include stderr excerpt.

jo: Perfect. Deadline: need artifact bundle (CSV + PNG + env.txt + 2-line caveat) by Mon 17:00 PT. If impossible, tell us now so we can simplify slide.

andy: Aiming for Sun EOD run, Mon morning artifacts. Minimal reproduce block we'll attach in the README:

```
# reproduce (example)
export RUNTIME_TOKEN=xxxxx
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN" \\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1,"quant":"fp16"}'
```

bench-bot: Run scheduled: id=lrch-1900-01, logs: /internal/bench/runs/lrch-1900-01, ETA ~4h.

liam: Ill attach the commit/hash and kernel mapping to the artifacts. Will post link here when done.

bench-bot: Run completed: id=lrch-1900-01, artifacts: /internal/bench/artifacts/lrch-1900-01.zip (CSV, heatmap.png, env.txt, README)

jo: Amazing — thanks team. Please @elena and @liam with the artifacts link so we can finalize copy and the single slide.
